text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> page fired: P2 - pg-primary-usw2 connection queueing. trigger: pg.connections_waiting > 200 (3m). routing: oncall-sre.

pagerduty: Page sent to Hana (SRE) and escalation policy.

Hana (SRE): acked. I'm up, looking. :mag:

Amar (Eng): seeing a huge spike in Redis timeouts right before the PG queueing. app-service logs show cache calls timing out, then requests opening DB txns and holding them.

Olivia (DB): confirmed on pg-primary: active connections ~ 2,450, max configured 3,000 but waiting queue is huge. pgbouncer shows `cl_waiting` ramping. Pg backend processes are fine but lots of idle in transaction + long-running.

Amar (Eng): here's a snippet from the app logs:```
2026-03-14T12:34:10Z WARN cache-lookup failed key=usr:123 err=EOF
2026-03-14T12:34:11Z WARN cache-lookup failed key=usr:456 err=MAXCLIENTS
2026-03-14T12:34:12Z INFO begin tx user_id=123
2026-03-14T12:34:30Z ERROR tx held 18.5s
```

Dalia (Platform): Redis metrics show `connected_clients` hitting 65k and `maxclients` is 64k on the primary raft. Evictions and slowlog increased. Probably client storms from a background job retry loop.

Hana (SRE): OK, immediate plan: 1) throttle incoming write-heavy endpoints via rate-limiter (flip flag) 2) kill the oldest ~30 blocking PG queries to free backends 3) add temporary pgbouncer route to read-replica for safe reads 4) scale Redis cluster to add shard capacity (if quick) 5) notify product + support about degraded service.

Mike (SRE): I'm on step 2/3. Running the safe query list now to pick long-running txns:```
SELECT pid, usename, state, query, now() - query_start AS age FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle' ORDER BY age DESC LIMIT 50;
```

Mike (SRE): terminating obvious stuck ones with `pg_terminate_backend(pid)` where age > 20s and not a replication slot. Doing 10 at a time. :wrench:

Olivia (DB): watch for cascading rollbacks, but that's fine, we need to free capacity. I'll monitor replication lag.

Amar (Eng): feature flag `feat/cache-heavy-throttle` ready, Dalia can you flip to 10rps? That should cut the retry storm.

Dalia (Platform): flipping now to 10 rps for the flagged endpoints. Patch applied to the edge rate limiter, propagated to all routes in ~30s. :white_check_mark:

Hana (SRE): after kills, connection waiters dropped from 220 -> 40. Nice. PG latency for simple selects back to baseline ~12ms. But app 5xxs still elevated for embedding endpoints.

Amar (Eng): embeddings failing due to cache miss flood + some model service backpressure. I recommend throttling embedding requests in host-api to avoid re-entrant retries. Adding a 429 gateway for now.

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by Hana, escalation halted.

Hana (SRE): customer impact: approx 3.2% of overall requests returned 5xx in last 10m; embeddings 503 rate ~12% in US-WEST targets. Key customers: 4 high-volume customers reported errors via support (IDs provided).

Dalia (Platform): Quick numbers from ingress: pre-mitigation rps 18k -> post throttle 9k. Error rate for core API down from 6% -> 1.8% in last 5m.

Olivia (DB): started a small pgbouncer scale and bumped `reserve_pool` temporarily. Monitoring for connection storms.

Mike (SRE): I'm going to put a short-term autoscale on Redis (add one shard) — provisioning now, ETA ~8m.

Amar (Eng): folks in product + support notified. Draft msg ready for status page if degradation continues: short blurb + mitigation steps.

Hana (SRE): Handoff plan: I'll remain on-call for the active fixes for 15m, then hand to Mike to monitor recovery. If issues reappear escalate to oncall-rotation-2.

Olivia (DB): replication lag minimal, read-replica now serving some offloaded reads. No WAL surge.

Dalia (Platform): Redis scaling completed: added one shard, client distribution rebalanced. connected_clients dropped to 35k. slowlog entries decreasing. :rocket:

Hana (SRE): Good. Next actions: 1) keep rate-limit for 30m, 2) follow up with engineering to patch retry logic that floods on cache timeouts, 3) run a post-incident RCA.

Amar (Eng): noted. I'll sync with the feature team and open a follow-up to limit retries + add jitter.

Mike (SRE): handing monitoring to me in 12m. If anything spikes, page me directly.

Hana (SRE): closing pager (for now). If error rate goes back up we re-open. Great work. :heart:

pagerduty: Incident: acknowledged -> resolved (auto) at 12:56:00Z by Hana (SRE).

Dalia (Platform): post-note: saved a snapshot of Redis slowlog + pgbouncer stats for RCA.

Olivia (DB): I'll follow up with a short writeup on why long transactions built up and a proposed knob change for pgbouncer defaults.

Participants: Hana, Mike, Olivia, Amar, Dalia, incident-bot, pagerduty.
